description: Turn a Playwright trace.zip (context.tracing / `--trace on`) or a *.spec.ts test file into demos/<name>/ with a draft storyboard: the run's own actions and selectors become scenes (cut at navigations and async payoffs), narration is left as placeholders, and `_notes` lists what was approximated. No LLM, no browser. Then write the narration and probe.

dir.description: repo to scaffold into (default: server cwd)

file.description: absolute path to trace.zip or the test file

name: import_trace
title: Draft a storyboard from a Playwright trace or test
